metadata.scenario: A customer calls to argue about a discrepancy in the billing amount and requests a detailed breakdown. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute. Customer type: returning_customer.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Helen Johnson. I'm calling about a billing issue I noticed on my last statement. Hi Helen, I'm glad you called. What seems to be the problem with your bill? Well, I noticed that the charges for my last physical therapy session were higher than what I've been paying. I see. Could you provide me with the specific amount you were charged? Sure, it was $145, but I thought it was supposed to be in the $110 to $140 range. Thank you for that information. Let me pull up your account to see the details. One moment, please. Of course, take your time. I just want to understand why there’s a discrepancy. Alright, I see that you had an additional service included during your last session. Additional service? I wasn’t informed about that during the appointment. I understand, Helen. It looks like you received some extra mobility training. But I didn't request that. I just needed my regular therapy. I apologize for the confusion. It should have been communicated to you clearly. Yes, communication is key, especially since I’m familiar with these processes. Absolutely, and I appreciate your understanding. Would you like me to adjust the billing for that session? Yes, please do. I’d like it to reflect the standard pricing. I can take care of that. It may take a few days for the credit to show on your account. Alright, that sounds good. Can I also get a detailed breakdown of my bill sent to my email? Certainly! Could you please confirm your email address for me? Yes, it’s helen.johnson@email.com. Thank you, Helen. You will receive that breakdown within the next 24 hours. Great! Also, I might be interested in adding some companion care for next week. That's wonderful to hear! I can connect you with Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator. Yes, please. I’d like to discuss that option further. Absolutely, I’ll have her reach out to you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that covers it. Thank you for your help, Margaret. You're very welcome, Helen! Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health. Have a great day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
